purpose: Scenario-transfer evaluation of SUMO C3-locked asymmetric FAR-Cal under permanent feedback loss
inference: Average paired effects across model and fault seeds within each episode, then bootstrap the 30 episodes with 2000 resamples.
superiority_rule: Both comparator-minus-candidate 95% episode-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero and aggregate 90% coverage must be at least 0.88.
interpretation_boundary: The asymmetric design was locked using C3 evidence; this is a scenario-transfer test on the existing held-out SUMO episodes, not a newly generated episode confirmation.
